x: John Gladwin gained a full senior vest in this the Citizen's Watch Challenge Cup and teamed up with Steve Cram in the 800m. John gave it all he had got sitting in on Cram during the first lap but his strength faded and he finished in a very creditable 4th ahead of the Kenyan and Japanese runners
Along with Steve Cram and Alan Wells, John was selected for drug testing. Training at the Belgrave Hall bar proved invaluable as John downed 7 lagers before obliging!!
It was also at this meeting that we saw the FIRST SUB 4 MINUTE MILE BY A BELGRAVIAN when Gary Staines chased home Steve Cram in a time of 3.59.24.
In the Senior race a few overseas competitors added a bit of spice while Steve Cram was running to a fine 6th place to confirm his new winter training programme.

At the Pearl Assurance International meeting held in Birmingham on 19 July, John Gladwin improved the club 800m record to 1.46.09 behind Steve Cram, having fought off 1.42 man Koskei down the home straight.
